class OptimalTouringCustomStrategy:
    def __init__(self, model: BaseStrategy):
        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)
            
    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        # sites_data is a dict: key=int (site id), value=dict with keys ['avenue', 'street', 'desiredtime', 'value', 'beginhour', 'endhour']
        sites_data = message.message[0].data[0]
        
        def compute_sequence(sites_data_dict):
            if not sites_data_dict:
                return []
            
            # Filter and create list of valid sites (can be visited alone)
            sites_list = []
            for sid, data in sites_data_dict.items():
                begin_min = data['beginhour'] * 60
                end_min = data['endhour'] * 60
                duration = data['desiredtime']
                if duration <= end_min - begin_min:  # Site can be visited within its window
                    value = data['value']
                    avenue = data['avenue']
                    street = data['street']
                    sites_list.append({
                        'id': sid,
                        'avenue': avenue,
                        'street': street,
                        'duration': duration,
                        'value': value,
                        'begin_min': begin_min,
                        'end_min': end_min
                    })
            
            if not sites_list:  # No valid sites
                return []
            
            # Create a dictionary for quick access by id
            site_dict = {s['id']: s for s in sites_list}
            
            # Find the starting site with the minimum begin_min
            start_site = min(sites_list, key=lambda s: s['begin_min'])
            start_id = start_site['id']
            sequence = [start_id]
            unvisited_ids = set(site_dict.keys()) - {start_id}
            
            current_ave = start_site['avenue']
            current_street = start_site['street']
            start_time_first = start_site['begin_min']
            end_visit_first = start_time_first + start_site['duration']  # Valid since filtered
            current_depart_time = end_visit_first
            
            # Greedily select the next site with earliest end time and highest value
            while unvisited_ids:
                feasible_ids = []
                for nid in unvisited_ids:
                    site = site_dict[nid]
                    travel_time = abs(current_ave - site['avenue']) + abs(current_street - site['street'])  # Manhattan distance as travel time in minutes
                    arrive_time = current_depart_time + travel_time
                    start_time_next = max(arrive_time, site['begin_min'])
                    end_time_next = start_time_next + site['duration']
                    if end_time_next <= site['end_min']:
                        feasible_ids.append(nid)
                
                if not feasible_ids:
                    break  # No more feasible sites to visit
                
                # Choose the site with min end_min, then max value (using -value for min function)
                next_id = min(feasible_ids, key=lambda nid: (site_dict[nid]['end_min'], -site_dict[nid]['value']))
                sequence.append(next_id)
                next_site = site_dict[next_id]
                
                # Update current position and depart time
                travel_time = abs(current_ave - next_site['avenue']) + abs(current_street - next_site['street'])
                arrive_time = current_depart_time + travel_time
                start_time_next = max(arrive_time, next_site['begin_min'])
                end_time_next = start_time_next + next_site['duration']
                current_depart_time = end_time_next
                current_ave = next_site['avenue']
                current_street = next_site['street']
                
                # Remove the visited site from unvisited set
                unvisited_ids.remove(next_id)
            
            return sequence
        
        visited_sites = compute_sequence(sites_data)
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
        )

            # Dynamic Programming setup
            MAX_MASK = 1 << n
            dp_table = [[float('inf') for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(MAX_MASK)]
            pred_table = [[-1 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(MAX_MASK)]

            best_mask = 0

        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

        )

    def compute_tour(self, sites_data: Dict[int, Dict]) -> List[int]:
        # Filter feasible sites where desired time fits within the window
        site_ids = [sid for sid in sites_data if sites_data[sid]['desiredtime'] <= (sites_data[sid]['endhour'] * 60 - sites_data[sid]['beginhour'] * 60)]
        n = len(site_ids)
        if n == 0:

        streets = [sites_data[sid]['street'] for sid in site_ids]
        desired_times = [sites_data[sid]['desiredtime'] for sid in site_ids]
        values = [sites_data[sid]['value'] for sid in site_ids]
        begin_min = [sites_data[sid]['beginhour'] * 60 for sid in site_ids]
        end_min = [sites_data[sid]['endhour'] * 60 for sid in site_ids]

        dist = [[abs(avenues[i] - avenues[j]) + abs(streets[i] - streets[j]) for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
        
        # Variables to keep track of the best tour
        max_value = 0
        best_path_ids = []
        
        # Define nested DFS function for backtracking
        def dfs(current_idx, current_end_time, visited_mask):
            max_add_val = 0
            best_path_add = []
            for next_idx in range(n):
                if (visited_mask & (1 << next_idx)) == 0:  # Check if not visited
                    travel_time = dist[current_idx][next_idx]
                    arrive_time = current_end_time + travel_time
                    begin_j = begin_min[next_idx]
                    end_j = end_min[next_idx]
                    desired_j = desired_times[next_idx]
                    start_time = max(begin_j, arrive_time)
                    if start_time + desired_j <= end_j:  # Feasible to visit
                        new_end_time = start_time + desired_j
                        new_visited_mask = visited_mask | (1 << next_idx)
                        add_val, add_path = dfs(next_idx, new_end_time, new_visited_mask)
                        total_val_for_j = values[next_idx] + add_val
                        if total_val_for_j > max_add_val:
                            max_add_val = total_val_for_j
                            best_path_add = [next_idx] + add_path
            return max_add_val, best_path_add
        
        # Try starting from each site
        for start_idx in range(n):
            start_time_S = begin_min[start_idx]
            end_time = start_time_S + desired_times[start_idx]
            if end_time <= end_min[start_idx]:  # Should always be true from filtering

                total_val = current_value + add_val
                full_path_indices = [start_idx] + add_path_indices

                    max_value = total_val
                    best_path_ids = [site_ids[idx] for idx in full_path_indices]

            end_min = sites_data_dict[site]['endhour'] * 60
            T_start = begin_min
            if T_start + dur > end_min:
                return False
            T_end_time = T_start + dur
            for i in range(1, len(order)):
                current_site = order[i]
                begin_current_min = sites_data_dict[current_site]['beginhour'] * 60
                end_current_min = sites_data_dict[current_site]['endhour'] * 60
                dur_current = sites_data_dict[current_site]['desiredtime']

                ave_curr = sites_data_dict[current_site]['avenue']
                str_curr = sites_data_dict[current_site]['street']
                travel_time = abs(ave_curr - ave_prev) + abs(str_curr - str_prev)
                T_arrive = T_end_time + travel_time

                if T_end_time > end_current_min:

            return True
        
        sites = list(sites_data_dict.keys())

Rules
-----
1. You are given a list of tourist sites. Each site has:
   - Avenue and street coordinates.
   - A desired visiting time (in minutes).
   - A reward value.
   - An available visiting window (start hour and end hour).
2. You can start your tour at any site.
3. The total duration includes:
   - The visiting time at each site.
   - The travel time between consecutive sites, measured by Manhattan distance (sum of absolute differences of avenues and streets).
4. You can only visit a site during its allowed visiting hours.
5. You want to maximize the total value collected in a single day.

Example  
--------
Here is an example of the site data:

| site | avenue | street | desired_time | value | begin_hour | end_hour |
|-----:|-------:|-------:|-------------:|------:|-----------:|---------:|
| 1    | 50     | 96     | 114          | 3     | 6          | 12       |
| 2    | 8      | 23     | 190          | 186   | 9          | 17       |
| 3    | 88     | 69     | 218          | 3     | 9          | 12       |
| 4    | 0      | 95     | 101          | 86    | 6          | 12       |
| 5    | 1      | 48     | 192          | 199   | 5          | 12       |

In this example, you can start by visiting site 5 at 5:00, then visit site 2. After that, the time will exceed 12:00, making other visits impossible. The total value you obtain is 199 + 186 = 385.

Task
----
Implement a Python strategy that, given the current `sites_data`, determines the sequence of sites to visit to maximize the total value collected.

**Input Format:**  
- `sites_data`: a dictionary where:

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Tuple, Union
from enum import Enum
from abc import abstractmethod

from system.message import Info
from system.message import BaseMessageDataType
from model.strategy_type import StrategyType
from model.base import BaseStrategy

class OptimalTouringCustomStrategy:
    def __init__(self, model: BaseStrategy):
        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)
            
    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        sites_data_dict = message.message[0].data[0]
        if not sites_data_dict:
            visited_sites = []
        else:
            site_ids = sorted(sites_data_dict.keys())
            n = len(site_ids)
            sites = []
            for sid in site_ids:
                data = sites_data_dict[sid]
                site = {
                    'id': sid,
                    'avenue': data['avenue'],
                    'street': data['street'],
                    'desired_time': data['desiredtime'],
                    'value': data['value'],
                    'begin_min': data['beginhour'] * 60,
                    'end_min': data['endhour'] * 60
                }
                sites.append(site)
            
            MAX_MASK = 1 << n
            dp = [[None for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(MAX_MASK)]
            
            # Base case for subsets of size 1
            for u in range(n):
                mask = 1 << u
                start_time = sites[u]['begin_min']
                finish_time = start_time + sites[u]['desired_time']
                dp[mask][u] = (sites[u]['value'], finish_time, -1)
            
            # DP for larger subsets
            for size in range(2, n + 1):
                for mask in range(MAX_MASK):
                    if bin(mask).count('1') == size:
                        for u in range(n):
                            if (mask & (1 << u)) != 0:
                                sub_mask = mask ^ (1 << u)
                                best_value = float('-inf')
                                best_finish_time = None
                                best_prev = -1
                                has_feasible = False
                                for v in range(n):
                                    if (sub_mask & (1 << v)) != 0:
                                        dp_sub_v = dp[sub_mask][v]
                                        if dp_sub_v is not None:
                                            val_v, finish_v, _ = dp_sub_v
                                            dist = abs(sites[v]['avenue'] - sites[u]['avenue']) + abs(sites[v]['street'] - sites[u]['street'])
                                            arrival_u = finish_v + dist
                                            start_u = max(arrival_u, sites[u]['begin_min'])
                                            if start_u <= sites[u]['end_min']:
                                                finish_u = start_u + sites[u]['desired_time']
                                                new_value = val_v + sites[u]['value']
                                                if new_value > best_value:
                                                    best_value = new_value
                                                    best_finish_time = finish_u
                                                    best_prev = v
                                                has_feasible = True
                                if has_feasible and best_value != float('-inf'):
                                    dp[mask][u] = (best_value, best_finish_time, best_prev)
                                else:
                                    dp[mask][u] = None
            
            # Find the maximum value over all masks and u
            max_value = float('-inf')
            best_mask = -1
            best_u = -1
            for mask in range(MAX_MASK):
                for u in range(n):
                    if dp[mask][u] is not None:
                        val = dp[mask][u][0]
                        if val > max_value:
                            max_value = val
                            best_mask = mask
                            best_u = u
            
            # If no sites can be visited or no valid dp entry
            if max_value == float('-inf'):
                path_indices = []
            else:
                # Reconstruct the path
                def get_path(dp_tab, m, u_idx):
                    path = []
                    current_mask = m
                    current_u = u_idx
                    while True:
                        path.append(current_u)
                        prev = dp_tab[current_mask][current_u][2]
                        if prev == -1:
                            break
                        sub_mask = current_mask ^ (1 << current_u)
                        current_u = prev
                        current_mask = sub_mask
                    path.reverse()  # Reverse to get start to end order
                    return path
                
                path_indices = get_path(dp, best_mask, best_u)
                # Map indices back to site IDs
                visited_sites = [sites[idx]['id'] for idx in path_indices]
        
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]

Def greedy_tour(sites_data):

  # Convert all times to minutes

  for site in sites_data.values():
    site['begin_time'] = site['beginhour'] * 60
    site['end_time'] = site['endhour'] * 60
    # desiredtime and value already there

  # Find all sites that are feasible individually, i.e., begin_time + desiredtime <= end_time
  feasible_sites = [sid for sid in sites_data if sites_data[sid]['begin_time'] + sites_data[sid]['desiredtime'] <= sites_data[sid]['end_time']]
  if not feasible_sites:
    return []  # no sites can be visited

  # Choose first site: the one with earliest begin_time
  first_site = min(feasible_sites, key=lambda sid: sites_data[sid]['begin_time'])
  # Or tie-break by highest value
  first_site = min(feasible_sites, key=lambda sid: (sites_data[sid]['begin_time'], -sites_data[sid]['value']))

  order = [first_site]
  visited = set([first_site])
  current_pos = (sites_data[first_site]['avenue'], sites_data[first_site]['street'])
  start_time = sites_data[first_site]['begin_time']  # start at begin time
  finish_time = start_time + sites_data[first_site]['desiredtime']

  while True:
    # Find unvisited sites that can be visited next
    candidates = []
    for sid in feasible_sites:
      if sid in visited:
        continue
      dist = abs(sites_data[sid]['avenue'] - current_pos[0]) + abs(sites_data[sid]['street'] - current_pos[1])
      arrival_time = finish_time + dist
      end_minus_service = sites_data[sid]['end_time'] - sites_data[sid]['desiredtime']
      if arrival_time <= end_minus_service:  # feasible to arrive
        # Can visit, start time S = max(arrival_time, begin_time)
        candidates.append((sid, dist, sites_data[sid]['value']))  # or just sid

    if not candidates:
      break  # no more sites can be visited

    # Choose the best candidate. For now, choose the one with highest value
    # Or closest distance to minimize travel
    # Perhaps highest value first
    next_site = max(candidates, key=lambda x: x[2])[0]  # max by value, get sid
    # Add to order
    order.append(next_site)
    visited.add(next_site)
    # Update position and time
    dist_to_next = abs(sites_data[next_site]['avenue'] - current_pos[0]) + abs(sites_data[next_site]['street'] - current_pos[1])
    arrival_time_next = finish_time + dist_to_next
    begin_time_next = sites_data[next_site]['begin_time']
    start_time_next = max(arrival_time_next, begin_time_next)
    finish_time = start_time_next + sites_data[next_site]['desiredtime']
    current_pos = (sites_data[next_site]['avenue'], sites_data[next_site]['street'])

  return order

        for i in range(1, len(sites)):

        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)
            
    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        # sites_data is provided in message.message[0].data[0]
        sites_data_dict = message.message[0].data[0]  # Dictionary of sites data
        
        # Extract site IDs and number of sites
        site_ids = list(sites_data_dict.keys())  # List of site IDs
        num_sites = len(site_ids)
        
        if num_sites == 0:
            visited_sites = []  # No sites to visit
        else:
            # Create lists for site data
            avenues = [0] * num_sites
            streets = [0] * num_sites
            desired_times = [0] * num_sites
            site_values = [0] * num_sites  # Use site_values to avoid potential keyword conflict
            begin_mins = [0] * num_sites
            end_mins = [0] * num_sites
            
            # Fill the lists with data, mapping index to site data
            for idx, site_id in enumerate(site_ids):
                data = sites_data_dict[site_id]
                avenues[idx] = data['avenue']
                streets[idx] = data['street']
                desired_times[idx] = data['desiredtime']
                site_values[idx] = data['value']
                begin_mins[idx] = data['beginhour'] * 60  # Convert hours to minutes
                end_mins[idx] = data['endhour'] * 60    # Convert hours to minutes
            
            # Define constants
            INF = 1000000  # A large number to represent infinity
            max_mask = 1 << num_sites  # Maximum mask value for subsets
            
            # Initialize DP and predecessor tables
            DP = [[INF for _ in range(num_sites)] for _ in range(max_mask)]
            pred = [[-1 for _ in range(num_sites)] for _ in range(max_mask)]  # Store predecessor for tracing path
            
            # Set base case for subsets of size 1
            for i in range(num_sites):
                mask = 1 << i
                DP[mask][i] = begin_mins[i] + desired_times[i]  # Earliest finish time when visiting only site i
            
            # Compute DP for larger subset sizes
            for size in range(2, num_sites + 1):  # Subset sizes from 2 to num_sites
                for mask in range(max_mask):  # Iterate over all masks
                    if bin(mask).count('1') == size:  # Check if mask has the correct subset size
                        for i in range(num_sites):  # For each possible end node i
                            if (mask & (1 << i)) != 0:  # If i is in the subset
                                submask = mask ^ (1 << i)  # Subset without i
                                min_finish = INF
                                best_j = -1
                                for j in range(num_sites):  # Try all possible predecessors j
                                    if (submask & (1 << j)) != 0:  # j must be in submask
                                        if DP[submask][j] < INF:  # If visiting submask ending at j is feasible
                                            dist_ji = abs(avenues[j] - avenues[i]) + abs(streets[j] - streets[i])  # Manhattan distance
                                            arrival_time = DP[submask][j] + dist_ji  # Arrival time at i
                                            start_i_time = max(arrival_time, begin_mins[i])  # Start time at i, with waiting
                                            if start_i_time <= end_mins[i]:  # Check if start time is within window
                                                finish_i_time = start_i_time + desired_times[i]  # Finish time at i
                                                if finish_i_time < min_finish:  # Minimize finish time
                                                    min_finish = finish_i_time
                                                    best_j = j  # Store the best predecessor
                                if min_finish < INF:  # If a feasible path exists
                                    DP[mask][i] = min_finish
                                    pred[mask][i] = best_j  # Store predecessor
                                else:
                                    DP[mask][i] = INF  # Mark as infeasible
            
            # Precompute sum of values for each subset mask
            sum_val = [0] * max_mask
            for mask in range(max_mask):
                for i in range(num_sites):
                    if mask & (1 << i):
                        sum_val[mask] += site_values[i]
            
            # Find the best mask with maximum sum value that is feasible
            best_sum_val = 0
            best_mask = 0
            best_end_i = -1
            for mask in range(max_mask):
                if mask == 0:
                    current_sum = 0
                    feasible = True  # Empty subset is feasible
                else:
                    # Check if there is any end node i in mask with finite DP value
                    feasible = False
                    for i in range(num_sites):
                        if (mask & (1 << i)) != 0 and DP[mask][i] < INF:
                            feasible = True
                            break
                    current_sum = sum_val[mask]
                if feasible and current_sum > best_sum_val:
                    best_sum_val = current_sum
                    best_mask = mask
                    # Find and store an end index i for tracing
                    if feasible and mask != 0:
                        for idx in range(num_sites):  # Use idx to avoid conflict with loop variable
                            if (mask & (1 << idx)) != 0 and DP[mask][idx] < INF:
                                best_end_i = idx
                                break  # Use the first feasible i
            
            # Trace back to find the path for the best mask
            if best_mask == 0:
                path_indices = []  # No sites to visit

                    prev_j = pred[current_mask_var][current_end]
                    submask_var = current_mask_var ^ (1 << current_end)
                    current_mask_var = submask_var
                    current_end = prev_j
                # Reverse the path to get correct order (from first to last)
                path_indices.reverse()
            
            # Convert path indices back to site IDs
            visited_sites = [site_ids[idx] for idx in path_indices]
        
        # For num_sites == 0, already set visited_sites = []
        
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
        )

        site['close_min'] = site['endhour'] * 60

        # No need to store deadline, compute when needed.

    best_value = 0

    best_path = []

    for start_id in possible_starts:

        # Simulate tour starting from start_id

        current_path = [start_id]

        current_value = sites_data[start_id]['value']

        current_position = (sites_data[start_id]['avenue'], sites_data[start_id]['street'])

        current_time = sites_data[start_id]['open_min']  # start at open time

        finish_time = current_time + sites_data[start_id]['desiredtime']

        unvisited = set(sites_data.keys()) - {start_id}

        while True:

            next_site = None

            max_value_next = -1

            for nid in unvisited:

                travel_time = abs(current_position[0] - site_n['avenue']) + abs(current_position[1] - site_n['street'])

def compute_tour(sites_data):

    # Convert hours to minutes

    for site_id in sites_data:

        site = sites_data[site_id]

        site['begin_min'] = site['beginhour'] * 60

        site['end_min'] = site['endhour'] * 60

        # keep other fields

    # Find site with min begin_min

    start_site_id = min(sites_data, key=lambda x: sites_data[x]['begin_min'])

    # Or if tie, min with max value or something, but for now min begin_min

    order = [start_site_id]

    visited = set([start_site_id])

    current_time = sites_data[start_site_id]['begin_min']  # start at begin time

    current_av = sites_data[start_site_id]['avenue']

    current_st = sites_data[start_site_id]['street']

    current_time += sites_data[start_site_id]['desiredtime']  # end time after visit

    total_value = sites_data[start_site_id]['value']

    # Now, while there are unvisited sites

    unvisited = set(sites_data.keys()) - {start_site_id}

    while unvisited:

        feasible_sites = []

        for site_id in unvisited:

            site = sites_data[site_id]

            travel_time = abs(current_av - site['avenue']) + abs(current_st - site['street'])

            arrival_time = current_time + travel_time

            start_visit = max(arrival_time, site['begin_min'])

            end_visit = start_visit + site['desiredtime']

            if end_visit <= site['end_min']:

                feasible_sites.append((site_id, site['end_min'], site['value']))  # or just site_id

        if not feasible_sites:

            break  # cannot visit more

        # Now, among feasible, choose one with min end_min, if tie, max value

        # Sort feasible_sites by end_min asc, then value desc

        feasible_sites.sort(key=lambda x: (x[1], -x[2]))  # x[1] is end_min, x[2] is value

        next_site_id = feasible_sites[0][0]  # first element is site_id, assuming I stored tuple (site_id, end_min, value)

        in the append, I put (site_id, end_min, value)

        yes.

        # Now, visit it

        order.append(next_site_id)

        visited.add(next_site_id)

        unvisited.remove(next_site_id)  # better to remove from unvisited

        site = sites_data[next_site_id]

        # Update time and location

        travel_time = abs(current_av - site['avenue']) + abs(current_st - site['street'])

        arrival_time = current_time + travel_time

        start_visit = max(arrival_time, site['begin_min'])

        # Wait time if any, but not needed

        end_visit = start_visit + site['desiredtime']

        current_time = end_visit  # end of visit

        current_av = site['avenue']

        current_st = site['street']

        total_value += site['value']  # optional, not needed for order

    # After this, order is the sequence

    return order

from model.strategy_type import StrategyType

class OptimalTouringCustomStrategy:
    def __init__(self, model: BaseStrategy):
        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)
            
    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        # sites_data is a dict: key=int (site id), value=dict with keys ['avenue', 'street', 'desiredtime', 'value', 'beginhour', 'endhour']
        sites_data = message.message[0].data[0]
        # compute the best tour
        visited_sites = self.find_best_tour(sites_data)
        # return data: list of integers representing the visiting order
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
        )

        site_ids = list(sites_data.keys())
        n = len(site_ids)
        if n == 0:
            return []

        sites = []
        for site_id in site_ids:
            site = sites_data[site_id].copy()  # Copy to avoid modifying original
            site['begin_time'] = site['beginhour'] * 60
            site['end_time'] = site['endhour'] * 60
            sites.append(site)
        
        # Variables to keep track of the best path
        best_value_var = [0]  # Use list to allow modification in nested function
        best_path_indices = [[]]
        
        def dfs(current_index, current_finish_time, visited_mask, current_value, path_indices):
            # Try to add next sites
            for next_index in range(n):
                if (visited_mask & (1 << next_index)) == 0:  # Not visited
                    next_site = sites[next_index]
                    travel_time = abs(sites[current_index]['avenue'] - next_site['avenue']) + abs(sites[current_index]['street'] - next_site['street'])
                    arrive_time = current_finish_time + travel_time
                    start_time = max(arrive_time, next_site['begin_time'])
                    if start_time <= next_site['end_time']:  # Can visit
                        new_finish_time = start_time + next_site['desiredtime']
                        new_value = current_value + next_site['value']
                        new_visited_mask = visited_mask | (1 << next_index)
                        dfs(next_index, new_finish_time, new_visited_mask, new_value, path_indices + [next_index])
            
            # After trying all possible next sites, update best if no more can be added
            if current_value > best_value_var[0]:
                best_value_var[0] = current_value
                best_path_indices[0] = path_indices[:]  # Copy the list to store the path
            
        # Try starting from each site
        for start_index in range(n):
            first_site = sites[start_index]
            start_time = first_site['begin_time']
            finish_time = start_time + first_site['desiredtime']
            value = first_site['value']
            visited_mask = 1 << start_index
            path = [start_index]  # Path starts with this index
            dfs(start_index, finish_time, visited_mask, value, path)
        
        # Convert the best path indices to site ids
        best_path_ids = [site_ids[idx] for idx in best_path_indices[0]]
        return best_path_ids

        def is_feasible(order):
            if not order:
                return True  # Empty order is feasible
            # First site
            first_id = order[0]
            begin_min = sites_data[first_id]['beginhour'] * 60
            end_min = sites_data[first_id]['endhour'] * 60
            desired_time = sites_data[first_id]['desiredtime']
            if begin_min + desired_time > end_min:
                return False
            start_visit = begin_min
            finish_time = start_visit + desired_time
            current_ave = sites_data[first_id]['avenue']
            current_street = sites_data[first_id]['street']

                next_begin_min = sites_data[next_id]['beginhour'] * 60
                next_end_min = sites_data[next_id]['endhour'] * 60
                next_desired_time = sites_data[next_id]['desiredtime']

                finish_time = start_visit_next + next_desired_time
                current_ave = next_ave
                current_street = next_street
            return True
        
        ids = list(sites_data.keys())
        n = len(ids)
        max_value = 0
        best_order = []
        
        for k in range(0, n + 1):  # Include empty subset
            for comb in itertools.combinations(ids, k):

                        if current_value > max_value:

2. You can start your tour at any site.
3. The total duration includes:

5. You want to maximize the total value collected in a single day.

        sites_data = message.message[0].data[0]
        # Get the site IDs and sort them to have a consistent order
        site_ids = sorted(sites_data.keys())
        n = len(site_ids)
        if n == 0:
            visited_sites = []
        else:
            # Create lists for fast access, with indices corresponding to site_ids order
            avenues = [sites_data[sid]['avenue'] for sid in site_ids]

            desired_times_min = [sites_data[sid]['desiredtime'] for sid in site_ids]  # already in minutes

            begin_times_min = [sites_data[sid]['beginhour'] * 60 for sid in site_ids]
            end_times_min = [sites_data[sid]['endhour'] * 60 for sid in site_ids]
            
            # Memoization dictionary
            memo = {}
            
            # Define the dynamic programming function
            def dp_func(current_pos: int, mask: int, current_time: int) -> tuple[int, list[int]]:
                key = (mask, current_pos, current_time)
                if key in memo:
                    return memo[key]
                max_add_val = 0  # Maximum additional value including the next site if visited
                best_seq = []  # Best sequence of indices starting from the next site
                for next_pos in range(n):

                        dist = abs(avenues[current_pos] - avenues[next_pos]) + abs(streets[current_pos] - streets[next_pos])

                        if start_time_next + desired_times_min[next_pos] <= end_times_min[next_pos]:
                            new_finish_time = start_time_next + desired_times_min[next_pos]
                            add_val_path = dp_func(next_pos, mask | (1 << next_pos), new_finish_time)
                            val_if_visit = values_list[next_pos] + add_val_path[0]  # Value of next site and after
                            if val_if_visit > max_add_val:
                                max_add_val = val_if_visit
                                best_seq = [next_pos] + add_val_path[1]  # Sequence starting from next_pos and after
                result = (max_add_val, best_seq)  # max_add_val is 0 and best_seq is [] if no valid next site
                memo[key] = result
                return result
            
            # Find the best starting point and sequence
            max_total_val = 0
            best_full_sequence_indices = []
            for first_pos in range(n):
                start_time_first = begin_times_min[first_pos]
                if start_time_first + desired_times_min[first_pos] <= end_times_min[first_pos]:  # Can visit first site

                    add_val_path = dp_func(first_pos, 1 << first_pos, finish_time_first)

from pydantic import BaseModel
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Any, Tuple, Union
from enum import Enum
from abc import abstractmethod

from system.message import Info
from system.message import BaseMessageDataType
from model.strategy_type import StrategyType
from model.base import BaseStrategy

class OptimalTouringCustomStrategy:
    def __init__(self, model: BaseStrategy):
        self._model = model
        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

    def update_model_field(self, field_name: str, value: Any):
        if hasattr(self._model, field_name):
            setattr(self._model, field_name, value)
            
    def receive_message(self, message: Info) -> Info:
        sites_data = message.message[0].data[0]
        # Filter feasible sites where the time window allows the visit
        feasible_sites = []
        for sid in sites_data:
            site = sites_data[sid]
            begin_min = site['beginhour'] * 60
            end_min = site['endhour'] * 60
            desired_min = site['desiredtime']
            if begin_min <= end_min - desired_min:
                feasible_sites.append(sid)
        
        if not feasible_sites:
            visited_sites = []
        else:
            best_val_overall = 0
            best_path_overall = []
            
            def recursive_best(remaining_sites, current_pos_ave, current_pos_st, current_end_time):
                if not remaining_sites:
                    return 0, []
                max_val = 0
                best_path = []
                for site_id in remaining_sites:
                    new_remaining = [s for s in remaining_sites if s != site_id]
                    site_data = sites_data[site_id]
                    travel_time = abs(site_data['avenue'] - current_pos_ave) + abs(site_data['street'] - current_pos_st)
                    arrival_time = current_end_time + travel_time
                    begin_min = site_data['beginhour'] * 60
                    desired_min = site_data['desiredtime']
                    end_min = site_data['endhour'] * 60
                    s_max = end_min - desired_min
                    start_time = max(arrival_time, begin_min)
                    if start_time <= s_max:
                        new_end_time = start_time + desired_min
                        val_suffix, path_suffix = recursive_best(new_remaining, site_data['avenue'], site_data['street'], new_end_time)
                        total_val_this = site_data['value'] + val_suffix
                        if total_val_this > max_val:
                            max_val = total_val_this
                            best_path = [site_id] + path_suffix
                return max_val, best_path
            
            for first_site in feasible_sites:
                site_first = sites_data[first_site]
                start_time_first = site_first['beginhour'] * 60
                end_time_after_first = start_time_first + site_first['desiredtime']
                remaining_after_first = [s for s in feasible_sites if s != first_site]
                val_suffix, path_suffix = recursive_best(remaining_after_first, site_first['avenue'], site_first['street'], end_time_after_first)
                total_val = site_first['value'] + val_suffix
                total_path = [first_site] + path_suffix
                if total_val > best_val_overall:
                    best_val_overall = total_val
                    best_path_overall = total_path
            visited_sites = best_path_overall
        
        return Info(
            sender=self.__class__.__name__,
            receiver=message.sender,
            difficulty=message.difficulty,
            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
        )

class OptimalTouringCustomStrategy:

        self.name = self._model.name
        self.history = self._model.history
        self.strategy_type = StrategyType.Custom

        sites_data = message.message[0].data[0]

        n = len(site_ids)

        site_info = {}
        for sid in site_ids:
            data = sites_data[sid]
            begin_min = data['beginhour'] * 60
            end_min = data['endhour'] * 60
            desired_time = data['desiredtime']
            latest_start = end_min - desired_time
            avenue = data['avenue']
            street = data['street']
            value = data['value']
            site_info[sid] = {
                'begin_min': begin_min,
                'latest_start': latest_start,
                'desired_time': desired_time,
                'value': value,
                'avenue': avenue,
                'street': street
            }
        # Find the best sequence using brute force over all permutations
        best_value = 0
        best_sequence = []
        for perm in itertools.permutations(site_ids):
            current_seq = []
            current_value = 0
            feasible = True
            current_time = None  # End time after last visit
            position = None  # Current position after last visit
            for site_id in perm:
                info = site_info[site_id]
                if len(current_seq) == 0:  # First site in the sequence
                    start_time = info['begin_min']
                    if start_time > info['latest_start']:
                        feasible = False  # Cannot visit this site even alone
                        break
                    end_time = start_time + info['desired_time']
                    current_seq.append(site_id)
                    current_value += info['value']
                    current_time = end_time
                    position = (info['avenue'], info['street'])
                else:  # Subsequent sites
                    dist = abs(position[0] - info['avenue']) + abs(position[1] - info['street'])
                    arrival_time = current_time + dist
                    begin_min_site = info['begin_min']
                    latest_start_site = info['latest_start']
                    start_time = max(arrival_time, begin_min_site)
                    if start_time > latest_start_site:
                        feasible = False  # Cannot visit this site, stop here
                        break  # The prefix up to current_seq is feasible
                    else:
                        end_time = start_time + info['desired_time']
                        current_seq.append(site_id)
                        current_value += info['value']
                        current_time = end_time
                        position = (info['avenue'], info['street'])
            # After processing the permutation (or breaking early), check the feasible prefix
            if current_value > best_value:
                best_value = current_value
                best_sequence = list(current_seq)  # Copy the current feasible sequence
        # Set the visited sites to the best sequence found
        visited_sites = best_sequence
        # Return the info with the custom data
        return Info(

            message=[BaseMessageDataType(data=visited_sites, type='custom')]
